Durations are written in ticks without a note type (quarter, eighth); a notation program engraves them from the duration.

Pulse width modulation, ring and sync partners, hard restart settings, level and chip volume changes are not exported; every instrument uses GoatTracker's default hard restart of 2 calls.
Rows are whole multiples of the row length; note starts and ends are moved to the nearest row.
